ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (14) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Наука» (nauka) is 'science' and «люди науки» (lyudi nauki) 'men of science'; the scare quotes around «наука» in the second thought are Tolstoy's. «Благо» (blago) is 'the good', and «суеверие» (sueverie, 'superstition') is repeated as in the source.
